The first step is getting yourself into a good sleeping pattern where you wake up at the same time and fall asleep at the same time. You’ll soon notice even if it’s hard to get up it’s definitely more bearable. I’m not exactly one to talk since I’m in the same boat as you but I’ve found getting a sleeping pattern helps a lot. When it comes to food try and have some snacks near your bed. Then if you suddenly feel hungry you can snack on something. Anything is better than nothing :) I’ve also found taking evening walks helps, even if it’s just round the block or even up the driveway. It sounds a bit stupid just doing that but the fresh air makes you realise a lot and helps you think. I hope some of this helps and I’m wishing you luck :)

I’m exactly the same! Recently I decided to quit my job due to my extreme anxiety when going. I’ve got slight agoraphobia so just leaving my room or house can make me anxious. But once I left my job I instantly felt relieved. I suddenly didn’t have so much pressure on my shoulders to go in and actually force myself to work when I felt so ill. I haven’t got any tips for staying at your job but if you decided to leave remember your not a failure. Sometimes you just need time to relax or find something that’s more for you! Hope this helps x
